params.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
Continue exactly from the start image: close-up of the man (navy crew-neck knit over a white t-shirt collar, black square glasses, short two-block hair with a side-swept fringe) in a bright cafe, green wall, window and plants softly out of focus behind him. He holds a dark smartphone at the bottom of the frame, screen toward himself.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
A friend at the next table films on a smartphone held vertically, eye level, 70mm look, tight close-up. Very light handheld breathing of 1 to 2 cm, no zoom, no pan. Modern phone video: clean, natural colors, no over-sharpening, no film grain.

ACTION
0.0s to 0.6s: he drops his eyes down to the phone screen in his hands, the half-smile fading, and raises the phone slightly so it is clearly what he is reading.
0.6s to 2.4s: still looking down at the phone, reading, he says the line in a flat voice without lifting his head; only his eyebrows rise a little.
2.4s to 3.0s: he keeps his eyes on the phone, blinks once, mouth closing into a flat line.

PERFORMANCE
Eyes stay on the phone the whole time he speaks; he does not look to the side or at anyone. Small expression changes, realistic stillness, deadpan sitcom timing, no exaggerated acting, no look at the camera.

AUDIO
Quiet cafe ambience, one soft short phone notification chime near the end. No music, no vibration.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same face, hair, glasses and clothes through the whole take. Only one phone in frame, held low, screen toward him. Same cafe background. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

DIALOGUE
The man says in Korean while looking down at the phone: "내가 다 읽는 거 아시는 거지?" Natural flat delivery, mouth movements match the words, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
